verdict.rationale: Egress to RTMP or HLS is a fair axis for a live media relay, so the story applies. The evidence pack covers only MoQ relay creation, token-scoped publish/subscribe and QUIC-based low-latency delivery, with no mention of RTMP or HLS egress or any output to a broadcast audience outside the session. Subscribe-only tokens let more viewers join the MoQ session itself, which is not egress.

support.subject: As a developer, a live session can be egressed to RTMP or HLS so a large audience watches without joining the session
